units.title: Durable tool input identity
units.summary: Anchor Learning persists an active tool operation together with its input snapshot, then validates that the snapshot still matches the checkpoint routing state before execution can continue.

questions.content: Which two values must coexist in a Anchor Learning checkpoint?
options: The active tool operation and its input snapshot
The deck id and review interval
The API key and model name
The session summary and XP total
questions.answer: The active tool operation and its input snapshot
questions.explanation: LearningAgentCheckpoint rejects a state when exactly one of the active operation and input snapshot is present.

body.reason: Both the persisted fields and the coexistence invariant are present in the cited source chunks.

questions.question: Explain how Anchor Learning preserves a tool operation's input identity in a checkpoint and which routing mismatches it rejects.

ai_responses.prompt_marker: 严格但建设性的 AI 应用开发面试评估官

body.feedback: You identified the operation id, but omitted the persisted input snapshot and the checkpoint routing-state comparisons.
body.reference_answer: Anchor Learning persists active_tool_operation_id and active_tool_input_snapshot together. The checkpoint requires both or neither, and rejects snapshots whose tool, target, focus point, or evidence chunk ids differ from the current routing state.
body.follow_up_question: Which routing fields are compared with the persisted input snapshot?
